literal_meaning: চরকি (চাকা বা সুতো কাটার যন্ত্র) ঘোরানো (ঘুরানো বা চালানো)
figurative_meaning_en: To harass someone by making them run around pointlessly
similar_in_english: Send on a wild goose chase
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আমাকে চরকি ঘোরানোর জন্য সারাদিন ঘোরাল।
অফিসে চাকরির জন্য চরকি ঘোরানো হয়েছে অনেকের সাথে।
example_sentences_in_english: He made me run around all day, spinning the charkhi on me.
Many people have been hassled by pointless errands in the office, like spinning a charkhi.
history: The idiom draws from the traditional rural practice of spinning thread on a charkhi (spinning wheel), symbolizing repetitive, futile labor in village life.
note: Rooted in pre-industrial Bengali rural economy where spinning wheels were common household tools.
